events.title: Demo Update - New Encounters, More Control, Less RNG
events.summary: Please note: This update requires a new character. Previous characters are no longer compatible with the current version.After reading your feedback and watching more people play, I realized the encounter system wasn’t working the way I’d hoped. It was often confusing, and the decisions didn’t feel meaningful enough.These encounters were designed early in development to offer a quick decision in each room. events.title: Impious v0.1.3(4) - Performance boost!
events.summary: This patch focused on fixing a couple of performance issues that were affecting performance on lower end devices, at the same time new rooms were designed and modelled with their specific loot containers.The performances issue was quite difficult to find, but luckily they were quite easy to fix, so I could boost the performance by ≈2.5 while putting new assets,loots and rooms at the same time.
